svg.title: A cached substitute waits beyond a one-way gate
svg.desc: Place original target and cached substitute around a one-way gate. Keep the unidentified run distinct from the named experiment elsewhere in the sequence. Visual distinction: A ratchet edge and an unpressed control identify a one-way action. No crossing arrow or activated state establishes an outcome.
